  • 10. Kakudhavagga 10. With Kakudha

Dutiyasampadāsutta Accomplishment (2nd)

“Pañcimā, bhikkhave, sampadā. “Mendicants, there are five accomplishments. Katamā pañca? What five? Sīlasampadā, samādhisampadā, paññāsampadā, vimuttisampadā, vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadā—Accomplishment in ethics, immersion, wisdom, freedom, and the knowledge and vision of freedom. imā kho, bhikkhave, pañca sampadā”ti. These are the five accomplishments.”

Dutiyaṁ.
